title: Chapter 427
text:
"Hiss!"

The sound of people sucking in a breath of air could be heard, and the surrounding crowd looked over in disbelief, envy, and jealousy. The people around Han Xiao hurriedly backed away, making him stand out.

"Who is this guy? What's his relationship with Chen Xing?"

"Why did they pick him?"

"What a lucky guy. Damn it, why can't it be me?"

Han Xiao's expression did not change, and he nodded. "Sure."

"Please follow me."

Chen Xing turned around, and Han Xiao followed behind. Chen Xing's assistant contacted the organizers, and the officials quickly found out about Han Xiao's identity. It turned out that he was a mercenary that they had worked with before, and he had Floating Dragon's background, so he could be trusted. Although it was not appropriate to let a mercenary enter the venue, they still agreed to this request on account of Han Xiao's clean background and Chen Xing's face.

They walked through the passage and boarded the celebration spaceship. Along the way, Sylvia was in a daze, not understanding what had happened. She had boarded the celebration that she had always dreamed of just like that. When she came back to her senses, she hurriedly pulled Han Xiao's clothes and said in surprise, "You really did it?"

"Based on my understanding of you, your memory doesn't seem to have dropped to the level of being retarded. Maybe I should let you memorize a few more books to train?" Han Xiao stared at Chen Xing's back and did not look away.

"I-I thought you were lying …" Sylvia did not know what to say. It was really like what Han Xiao had said. The two of them had been invited onto the spaceship, but she would never have dreamed that the person who invited them would be Chen Xing. Furthermore, it seemed like it was an impromptu decision.

She suppressed her excitement and asked impatiently, "How did you do it?"

"No amount of people can hide my charm," Han Xiao said perfunctorily.

The real reason was naturally the mysterious statue that Han Xiao had with him. Chen Xing had a special perception of the Psychic Current contained in the statue. As long as it was within a certain range, it would definitely attract his attention. Therefore, Han Xiao knew that Chen Xing would invite him onto the spaceship because of this.

…

After everyone boarded the ship, the major cities on the main planet let off a series of fireworks. Then, the Wine and Celebration took off with a rumble, orbiting around the main planet of Ferran. The body of the ship emitted brilliant lights, and when the people on the surface looked up, they could also see the giant spaceship that was like an orbiting celestial body.

Han Xiao was arranged to sit in the VIP room of Chen Xing's team. Chen Xing did not talk to him immediately. Instead, he went to prepare for the program. He instructed his assistant that if Han Xiao asked why he was invited, he was to tell him that he would meet with him privately after the ceremony.

However, the assistant waited for a long time, but Han Xiao did not show any curiosity. After entering the room, he closed his eyes and rested, as if he did not care at all about why he was invited. After waiting for a long time, the assistant had no choice but to speak first.

"This … Your Excellency, Chen Xing wishes to speak with you after the ceremony. Please be patient and enjoy the performance."

"Mm." Han Xiao was a man of few words.

In fact, he knew everything about Chen Xing and had no intention of asking.

After a while, the audience sat down. Qiong, you are a galactic mercenary, so I would like to ask you to help me find the last two statues. For this, I will pay you a reward. How about 100,000 Enas? "

"Ten, ten …" Sylvia almost suffocated.

Wasn't this a little too extravagant?

Han Xiao was not surprised. It was very normal for celebrities to be rich.

Furthermore, this mission was famous in his previous life because the reward did not match the difficulty of the mission at all.

"Sure, do you have any requests?" Han Xiao's lips curled up slightly.

"As for requests …" Chen Xing tapped his lips with his finger. "Of course, the faster the better."

You have triggered a Grade C Mission: Find the Statues.

Mission Introduction: A singer named Chen Xing is collecting a special type of statue. He hopes that you can find the remaining statues for him.

Mission Requirements: Find the other two mysterious statues.

Note: When you have two statues, you will notice if there are other statues within a certain range.

Basic Reward: 10 Enas, 110 EXP.

After the mission ends, a rating will be given based on the time taken. The shorter the time taken, the higher the rating, and additional rewards will be given.

"I've got the mission."

Han Xiao squinted his eyes.

This was the mission that he had specifically wanted to trigger. He had searched through his memory and listed the most suitable missions for him to get a high rating.

Searching for the items was not difficult, but it was very time-consuming. He had to run around to find the location of the other statues and ask for information from many people. The process was very complicated, and time was the basis of the rating.

However, to Han Xiao, it was not difficult at all. Thanks to the players in his previous life, he knew the location of the last two statues himself, so he could skip the search process and go straight to the root of the problem. There was no doubt that he would get a high rating.

He did not want to go straight to Grade A, so he had to take a roundabout route and use the chance of a random reward to draw a Mission Completion Card.

The reward of the mission itself was not important; the random reward was the key.
